test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Mother said that Sam would not pass.

options.text: Mother said, “Sam will have never passed.”

solution:
The correct answer is **"Mother said, 'Sam will not pass.'"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The rules for changing Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Future Tense.
 
• In Future Tense, would changes to will.
 
• Insert the commas and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use that in the sentence of direct speech.
 
• **Structure: **
 
• **Subject + will + verb (Direct speech)**
 
• **Subject + would + verb (Indirect speech)**
 
 
• Example: *John said to me, "There will be a seminar" *(Direct speech)
 
 
 
 

 * John asked me that there would be a seminar.* (Indirect speech)

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2**.
